methods.name: Structural time series (local level, local linear trend, BSM) by maximum likelihood, fixed variances
methods.reference: stats::StructTS(type = 'level' | 'trend' | 'BSM', fixed); tight optimum of its objective; stats::KalmanRun / KalmanSmooth (nit = -1)
quantities: variances (level, slope, seas, epsilon) at the tight optimum
methods.tolerance: tight coefficients Tol::iterative(1e-6); log-likelihoods Tol::stat(n) (n = 100, 108); states and residuals rel 1e-6 abs 1e-8; R's own L-BFGS-B coefficients 1e-4 (Nile), 2e-3 (UKgas): the measured gaps of R's early stop

deviations.quantity: StructTS's reported log-likelihood with missing values (nile_na_loglik, nile_na_loglik_tight)
deviations.note: R scales the data term by length(y)/n_obs; p2a reports the observed-data Gaussian log-likelihood, pinned to nile_na_loglik_obs_tight from the same written-out objective; series without gaps are unaffected

methods.name: Kalman filter, Durbin-Koopman smoother and forecast with state and observation intercepts
methods.reference: stats::KalmanRun / KalmanLike / KalmanSmooth / KalmanForecast (nit = -1) on the model augmented with a constant state
quantities: smoothed level, slope and level variance
smoothed level with a singular predicted covariance
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 50: states, innovations, forecasts 1e-6 relative; log-likelihood 1e-5
